title: 第3章 剑与少年第4章 希望第5章 白狐
content_zh:
“唔”伤口处传来的疼痛让杨修到吸一口凉气，身子的摇晃感使杨修逐渐清醒，然而一睁眼陌生的环境让杨修充满了疑惑，他的记忆停留在身体掉入湖水的那一刻，而现在的情景好像是在一辆华丽的马车内，他用尽浑身力气起身打量四周，映入眼帘的是马车内部的华丽，以及一名少女，少女齿白唇红、肌肤胜雪只是皱起的的眉头和脸上的憔悴让人知道她的心情并不是太好，让杨修更为惊讶的是少女穿着的是皇室特有的材质，这让杨修内心不由升起一丝紧张感。
少女察觉到身后的异响回头看到杨修醒来眉头舒展了一下开口说道“你醒了呀！”
杨修微微点头随后恭敬道“谢谢你，请问你是？”
听到杨修的话语少女眼神闪过一丝伤感，刚刚舒展的眉头又重新皱了起来但还是轻轻开口道“前皇帝第七女，郑元雪”
杨修听到女生的回答后，知道问到少女痛处了赶忙道歉道“抱歉！我不该问这个问题的”
“没关系的！”少女话语中带着一丝叹息的意味。
杨修不知道怎么接话，想安慰又不知道怎么开口，车内陷入了安静，这让从小不知道与人如何相处的杨修感觉到很尴尬。
“我看过你身上的伤口，这应该是箭伤，看伤口的形状应该是兵部特有的箭矢，我很好奇你的身份？”少女突然的询问打破了尴尬的气氛。
杨修听到了少女的话，想起了杨家的惨状又一时间不知道怎么开口回答少女的问题，低头沉思。
“不方便回答可以不说”少女似乎也不喜欢尴尬的气氛想试图终结这个话题。
杨修深呼吸一口说道“我是杨府的幸存者”
“杨府？将军府杨府？”少女惊叹道。
“是的。”杨修试图压下内心的伤痛但是语气中还是带着一丝颤抖。
少女这时也知道这少年内心的伤痛和自己差不多，杨氏将军府被灭满门的事件整个王都人尽皆知，而且原因是因为自己父皇不免内心升起了一丝亲近感，随后从储物戒里拿出了一个小瓶子，“这是疗伤的药，关于将军府的事，我代我死去的父皇，向你说声抱歉，之前怕你是十恶不赦之人并未给你吃疗伤的药。”
杨修听到少女的话语心中的伤痛减少了一丝，“没关系的和你，说的一样没关系的！”
“还没问过你的名字？”少女知道杨修身份后言语也多了起来。
“杨修”杨修接过疗伤药吃了下去。
“我听说将军府实际死亡的人数与将军府原本的人数对不上，好像是少了两人，一个是你另一个你知道是谁吗？”少女道。
杨修刚想说不知道但是，想到了之前杨无平说的话，“应该是堂兄杨无敌”，突然间他想通了为什么无敌哥回来不到一周又出去狩猎了还带走了惊云枪，也对既然父母都知道皇帝要拜，作为族长嫡系孙子也是杨府最为天骄的无敌哥肯定也是被保护起来了，想到无敌哥，杨修眼神中亮了起来，心中想到，以无敌哥的天赋肯定会修炼有成为杨府满门报仇的吧。
少女听到杨修的话语沉默了一下，有带着一丝颤抖开口道“你说的是，杨府最有可能凝聚灵宝的杨无敌”虽然声音颤抖但是无疑此刻内心是带着喜悦的。

杨无敌和郑元淳是整个王都都知道两个天骄，此次九王爷谋反也是为了自己的儿子，匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪的道理都懂，九王爷一脉出了麒麟子，在皇帝眼中无疑是眼中钉，所以九王爷为了儿子只能谋反，杨无敌在王都除了天骄的盛名外，也是王都少数的俊男，虽未到成家年纪，在王都希望和杨无敌结亲的女子也不在少数，据说皇帝也打算招纳其为驸马，一来可以拉拢杨家巩固地位，二来也可以将这一天骄打上自己皇室一脉的标签，可惜的是杨无敌是个不折不扣的武痴，对于情爱一事从来不关注。
杨修望着少女的看到了她的一丝喜悦知道其也应是对无敌哥暗生情愫之人开口道“是的。”
听到杨修的肯定女生眉头也彻底舒展开虽未多言，但是喜于言表。
听着哒哒的马蹄声，杨修开口“公主殿下，请问你这是准备去哪里？”
“我并未被封公主，你大可不必这么拘束直呼我名就好，我打算去镇西关到云墨先生那里求学”郑元雪并未隐瞒将自己的行程说出。
杨修听到云墨的名字想了一下，云墨先生之名在大乾可是受人尊敬的，这位先生虽无修为可其在文人心中的地位可是不低的，云墨先生年纪不大却饱读诗书，他从少年时便游走无垠大陆求学，如今决心定居在镇西关就是为了将所学知识传授世人，云墨先生传学只看缘分，并不在乎种族，就连魔族和妖族都有在镇西关求学，因此镇西关被称为最安定的城的原因也是仰仗云墨先生。
“我可以与殿下同行吗？”杨修开口
“当然可以”郑云雪没有犹豫就答应到，随后想了一下又道，“你知道杨无敌的下落吗？”
小主，这个章节后面还有哦，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！
杨修摇了摇头，郑元雪失落了一下，然后开口“没关系，知道他活着就可以了”
“咕”这时杨修的肚子突然间响了一下，“噗嗤”真声不合时宜的响声逗的郑元雪一笑，“饿了吧！我们去吃点东西吧”随后也没管杨修答不答应就叫停了马车然后率先下车，杨修本打算忍着疼痛起身结果发现伤口居然愈合了，心中不免惊讶，这皇室的疗伤药神奇。
杨修下车发现郑元雪带的人并不多，一个落魄的公主带着太多的侍卫好像更不符合常理，侍卫里面有一剑眉星目之人，队伍刚停下就找到一颗树，在练剑，杨修自幼习武因为天赋原因在枪道造诣一直平平无奇，但他无疑是努力的，看到和自己一样努力的人勾起了内心想练枪的心，尴尬的是自己身边根本没有枪。
郑元雪转身看到了愣在原地的杨修，顺着他的目光看去发现了正在练剑的周平山，轻笑一句“你们杨家不是以枪法出名？怎么想练剑？”
杨修听到调侃的话，慌忙摆手，“不是，我也想练枪但是手中没有”
“我没有枪给你一把剑吧，食物还有一会才弄好要不你先和周平山练练？”郑元雪伸手从储物戒中取出一把剑扔给杨修。
杨修本来想算了看到扔来的剑伸手接过，摇了摇头走到周平山身边观察。
周平山发觉到来人，看清样貌发现是郑元雪前段时间在水潭救的人惊讶于他醒来的速度，他被来以为会一个周才醒，没想到杨修三天就醒了，“怎么想练剑？”
杨修听到周平山的话点点头开口道“想学习一下”
周平山笑了一下将剑放入剑鞘开口道“看好了，我只演示一遍。”
只见一股气势在剑鞘中凝聚，随后周平山拔剑而出一剑斩在树上，一米粗的树被斩断了一半剑卡在了树中，周平山满意一笑，随后抽出剑冲杨修挑眉一笑，“你来”

杨修点点头走过去伸手摸到剑柄，他从出生从来没有练过剑但是当他摸到剑柄的那一刻一股气势从剑中传来这剑好像是他的身体的一部分一般，他的并未多想脑海中回想着刚才周平山那一剑然后一剑斩出。
周平山看到杨修走过去本来脸上带着笑容的，可当杨修手摸到剑柄那一刻一股气势从剑中传来，这气势好像比他施展拔剑术的时候威势更强，脸上的笑容收敛了，随着杨修一剑斩出面容一脸惊愕，杨修斩的位置比周平山刚才斩的位置偏下可是一剑斩入树中的的位置可是来到了四分之三。
杨修睁眼看到自己的成果不免内心升起了一丝疑惑，这是他第一次练剑，看周平山的样式他应该练了许久，自己做到的比他还好难道他不适合练枪适合练剑？
“你以前学过这招？你是什么境界？”周平山惊呼的一秒问出了两个问题。

content_en:
"Hmm" The pain from the wound made Yang Xiu take a deep breath, and the shaking feeling in his body made Yang Xiu gradually wake up. However, when he opened his eyes, the unfamiliar environment filled Yang Xiu with doubts. His memory stayed at the moment when his body fell into the lake, and the current scene seemed to be in a gorgeous carriage. He used all his strength to get up and look around. All around, what came into view was the gorgeous interior of the carriage, as well as a girl. The girl had white teeth and red lips, and her skin was as good as snow. But her wrinkled brows and haggard face made it clear that she was not in a good mood. What surprised Yang Xiu even more was that the girl was wearing a material unique to the royal family, which made Yang Xiu feel a little nervous.
The girl noticed the strange noise behind her and turned around to see Yang Xiu waking up. Her brows stretched and she said, "You're awake!"
Yang Xiu nodded slightly and then said respectfully, "Thank you, who are you?"
After hearing Yang Xiu's words, the girl's eyes flashed with sadness, and her brows that had just relaxed were furrowed again, but she still said softly, "The seventh daughter of the former emperor, Zheng Yuanxue."
After Yang Xiu heard the girl's answer, he knew that he had asked about the girl's sore point and quickly apologized, "Sorry! I shouldn't have asked this question."
"It's okay!" There was a hint of sigh in the girl's words.
Yang Xiu didn't know how to answer. He wanted to comfort but didn't know how to speak. The car fell into silence, which made Yang Xiu, who had not known how to get along with others since he was a child, feel very embarrassed.
"I've seen the wound on your body. It should be an arrow wound. The shape of the wound should be an arrow unique to the Ministry of War. I'm curious about your identity?" The girl suddenly asked, breaking the awkward atmosphere.
Yang Xiu heard the girl's words and thought of the tragic situation of the Yang family. He didn't know how to answer the girl's question for a while, and lowered his head in thought.
"You don't have to say it if it's not convenient for you to answer." The girl didn't seem to like the awkward atmosphere and wanted to end the topic.
Yang Xiu took a deep breath and said, "I am a survivor of the Yang Mansion."
"Yang Mansion? General Yang Mansion?" the girl exclaimed.
"Yes." Yang Xiu tried to suppress the pain in his heart but there was still a tremor in his tone.
At this time, the girl also knew that the pain in the young man's heart was similar to hers. The whole family of General Yang's Mansion was wiped out by everyone in the kingdom, and the reason was because her father could not help but feel a sense of closeness in her heart. Then she took out a small bottle from the storage ring, "This is healing medicine. Regarding the matter of the General's Mansion, I apologize to you on behalf of my deceased father. I was afraid that you were a heinous person and I did not give you the healing medicine."
When Yang Xiu heard the girl's words, the pain in his heart lessened a little, "It doesn't matter, it's the same as what you said, it doesn't matter!"
"I haven't asked you your name yet?" The girl became more talkative after knowing Yang Xiu's identity.
"Yang Xiu" Yang Xiu took the healing medicine and drank it.
"I heard that the actual number of deaths in the General's Mansion does not match the original number of people in the General's Mansion. It seems that there are two people missing. One is you and the other is you, do you know who it is?" the girl said.
Yang Xiugang wanted to say that he didn't know, but he thought of what Yang Wuping said before, "It should be my cousin Yang Wudi." Suddenly he figured out why Brother Wuwei went hunting again less than a week after he came back and took away the Cloud Shocking Gun. Since both his parents knew about the emperor, After all, Brother Wudi, who is the direct grandson of the clan leader and the most talented person in the Yang family, must have been protected. Thinking of Brother Wudi, Yang Xiu's eyes lit up, and he thought in his heart, with Brother Wudi's talent, he will definitely be able to practice and become the vengeance of the Yang family.
The girl was silent for a moment after hearing Yang Xiu's words, and said with a hint of trembling, "You are talking about Yang Wudi who is most likely to condense the spiritual treasures in the Yang family." Although her voice was trembling, there was no doubt that she was filled with joy in her heart at this moment.
Yang Wudi and Zheng Yuanchun are two geniuses known to the entire royal capital. This time the Ninth Prince rebelled because of his own son. A common man is not guilty, but he knows the reason why he is guilty of carrying a jade.The Ninth Prince has a Qilin son, who is undoubtedly a thorn in the emperor's side, so the Ninth Prince has no choice but to rebel for the sake of his son. Yang Wudi is not only famous as a genius in the capital, he is also one of the few handsome men in the capital. Although he has not reached the age of getting married, there is a woman in the capital who hopes to marry Yang Wudi. There were also quite a few. It was said that the emperor also planned to recruit him as his consort. Firstly, he could win over the Yang family to consolidate his status. Secondly, he could label this prodigy as a member of his royal family. Unfortunately, Yang Wudi was an out-and-out martial arts fanatic and never paid attention to love.
Yang Xiu looked at the girl and saw a hint of joy in her. He knew that she must be the one who had a secret crush on Brother Invincible and said, "Yes."
After hearing Yang Xiu's affirmation, the girl's brows widened completely. Although she didn't say much, she was overjoyed.
Listening to the clatter of horse hooves, Yang Xiu said, "Your Highness, where are you going?"
"I have not been named a princess. You don't have to be so restrained in calling me by my first name. I plan to go to Zhenxiguan to study with Mr. Yun Mo." Zheng Yuanxue did not hide her itinerary.
Yang Xiu thought for a moment when he heard Yunmo's name. Mr. Yunmo's name is respected in Daqian. Although this gentleman has no cultivation, his status in the hearts of literati is not low. Mr. Yunmo is young but has read a lot of poetry and books. He has been traveling around the endless continent to study since he was a boy. Now he is determined to settle in Zhenxiguan in order to pass on the knowledge he has learned to the world. Mr. Yunmo's teaching only depends on fate and does not care about race. Even the demons and demons have studied in Zhenxiguan. Therefore, the reason why Zhenxiguan is called the most stable city is also due to Mr. Yunmo.
"Can I go with His Highness?" Yang Xiu asked
"Of course," Zheng Yunxue agreed without hesitation, then thought for a moment and said, "Do you know the whereabouts of Yang Wudi?"

Yang Xiu shook his head, Zheng Yuanxue was disappointed for a moment, and then said, "It doesn't matter, as long as you know he is alive, it will be fine."
"Gu" At this time, Yang Xiu's stomach suddenly made a sound, "Pfft", the real and untimely sound made Zheng Yuanxue smile, "You are hungry! Let's go get something to eat." Then he stopped the carriage without caring about Yang Xiu's answer and got out of the car first. Yang Xiu originally planned to endure the pain and got up but found that the wound was actually healed. He couldn't help but be surprised. This royal healing medicine is miraculous.
Yang Xiu got out of the car and found that Zheng Yuanxue didn't have many people with him. It seemed even more unreasonable for a down-and-out princess to have too many guards. Among the guards was a man with sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes. As soon as the team stopped, they found a tree and were practicing swordsmanship. Yang Xiu had been practicing martial arts since he was a child, but his gun skills were mediocre due to his talent.
Zheng Yuanxue turned around and saw Yang Xiu, who was stunned. She followed his gaze and found Zhou Pingshan who was practicing swordplay. She chuckled, "Isn't your Yang family famous for your marksmanship? Why do you want to practice swordsmanship?"
Yang Xiu heard the ridicule and waved his hands hurriedly, "No, I also want to practice shooting but I don't have it in my hand."
"I don't have a gun, let me give you a sword. The food won't be ready for a while, why don't you practice with Zhou Pingshan first?" Zheng Yuanxue reached out and took out a sword from the storage ring and threw it to Yang Xiu.
Yang Xiu originally wanted to forget it, but when he reached out to take the thrown sword, he shook his head and walked to Zhou Pingshan to observe.
Zhou Pingshan noticed the person coming and saw his appearance clearly and found that it was Zheng Yuanxue. The person he rescued in the pool some time ago was surprised at how quickly he woke up. He thought it would take him a week to wake up, but he didn't expect Yang Xiu to wake up in three days. "Why do you want to practice swordsmanship?"
Yang Xiu nodded when he heard Zhou Pingshan's words and said, "I want to learn something."
Zhou Pingshan smiled, put the sword into the scabbard and said, "Watch it, I will only demonstrate it once."
I saw a momentum gathering in the scabbard, and then Zhou PingShan drew his sword and slashed it on the tree. Half of the one-meter-thick tree was cut off and the sword got stuck in the tree. Zhou Pingshan smiled with satisfaction, then drew out his sword and raised his eyebrows at Yang Xiu and smiled, "Here you go."
Yang Xiu nodded and walked over and reached out to touch the hilt of the sword. He had never practiced a sword since he was born, but the moment he touched the hilt, a momentum came from the sword. The sword seemed to be a part of his body. Without thinking much, he recalled Zhou Pingshan's sword just now and slashed out with one sword.
Zhou Pingshan originally had a smile on his face when he saw Yang Xiu walking over, but when Yang Xiu touched the hilt of the sword, a momentum came from the sword. This momentum seemed to be more powerful than when he used the sword drawing technique.
When Yang Xiu opened his eyes and saw his results, he couldn't help but feel a little doubt in his heart. This was his first time practicing swordsmanship. Judging from Zhou Pingshan's style, he must have been practicing for a long time. He was better than him. Isn't he suitable for practicing spears and swords?
"Have you learned this trick before? What state are you in?" Zhou Pingshan asked two questions in one second as he exclaimed.
